description:
AI-assisted resume tailoring and cover-letter generation for Chrome.

HirePilot combines a local Windows backend with a Chrome extension to tailor
resumes, generate cover letters, create DOCX and PDF files, and assist with
form filling. Users provide their own supported LLM API keys or local model.
This release includes the HirePilot Windows companion: local backend, tray
controls, updater, protocol launcher, and bundled PDF runtime. The Chrome
extension is installed and updated separately through the Chrome Web Store.
